label: OmniTIK 5 ac
description: MikroTik OmniTIK 5 ac (RBOmniTikG-5HacD) — 5x 1G RJ45, Wi-Fi 5 GHz. MIPSBE 1-core QCA9557.
notes: Inlet is `eth1` at 14 W; the OmniTIK 5 ac has no PoE-out. https://mikrotik.com/product/rbomnitikg_5hacd (read 2026-11-28): "Number of DC inputs 1 (PoE-IN)", "PoE in Passive PoE", "PoE in input Voltage 12-57 V", "Max power consumption 14 W", no PoE-out section. The brochure https://cdn.mikrotik.com/web-assets/product_files/OmniTIK_5_ac_171051.pdf prints "Consumption 14 W" for this SKU (18 W for the PoE version) and puts "PoE out - Yes, Ether2 - Ether5" on the PoE version only. https://manual.mikrotik.com/hardware/omnitik-series/ names no port; eth1 is the one port of the five that the PoE-out list leaves, and the one the quick guides call the WAN/First Ethernet port. The row used to spell `poeIn: true` and leave eth2-eth5 silent: 64.75 W guessed at 12.95 W apiece on a 14 W board.
